_comment: Harness case H-COL-003: FetchResult for a source that returns HTTP 500 on every attempt. Because 5xx errors are retryable, the collector retries until the retry budget (max_retries=4, total backoff cap at 30s) is exhausted. All 5 attempts are recorded, and ok remains false. Used to verify that the retry loop respects its budget ceiling.
